issue.title: Catch phases that end without closing their bead, and stop agents from working the wrong bead
issue.description: A phase agent that misreads its own bead ID is warned or refused at the CLI. A single-turn phase that ends with its bead still open is classified stranded and raises one wait alert. A follow-on epic proposed after its bead closed no longer nests under it.
issue.creation_reason: Approved epic plan plan:202610/stranded_phase_detection_and_wrong_bead_guard.md requests this work

issue.title: Let the stranded-work collector see single-turn sessions
issue.description: stranded-root-members: add an agent_name candidate-filter field to the sase-core artifact index and query agent_session OR agent_name from the stranded collector, so a session's root member (agent_session null) is no longer reported unknown/no_records.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202610/stranded_phase_detection_and_wrong_bead_guard.md defines phase stranded-root-members as one work unit

issue.title: Raise one wait alert per stranded bead a live waiter is blocked on
issue.description: stranded-bead-wait-alert: make wait_checks classify the unclosed beads that live waiters block on through a targeted, TTL-cached stranded-work collection, and upsert one deduplicated, self-dismissing notification per stranded bead with its cause and relaunch command.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202610/stranded_phase_detection_and_wrong_bead_guard.md defines phase stranded-bead-wait-alert as one work unit

issue.title: Warn or refuse when an agent targets a one-segment near-miss of its assigned bead
issue.description: assigned-bead-near-miss: detect, inside SASE agents, bead IDs that differ from the assigned bead by one inserted or deleted non-trailing segment; banner the read output, refuse close/open per the near_miss_mutation decision, and tighten the phase and task work prompts.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202610/stranded_phase_detection_and_wrong_bead_guard.md defines phase assigned-bead-near-miss as one work unit

issue.title: Stop plan propose from parenting new epics under an already-closed bead
issue.description: closed-parent-stamp: skip the automatic parent_bead stamp in sase plan propose when the proposing agent's active bead is already closed, so follow-on campaign epics are top-level instead of growing the ID one segment per batch.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202610/stranded_phase_detection_and_wrong_bead_guard.md defines phase closed-parent-stamp as one work unit

payload.entry: LANDING FOLLOW-UP TRIAGE: Reviewed all child notes. The three capacity-fixture proposals (sase-1ok.1#1, sase-1ok.2#1, sase-1ok.3#2) are one defect caused by active epic sase-1oj dead-PID pruning; recorded DISCOVERED ISSUE on sase-1oj, including sase-1oj.4 report of an already-tested fix not yet present in fetched cef4bb1199. Declined a separate task as causally owned there. The gateway IPC flake from sase-1ok.1#2 duplicates exact-node task sase-1gz; relayed the independent phase evidence as +1 (now +9). The Machines-pane flake from sase-1ok.3#1 duplicates sase-1ax; relayed it as +1 (now +1). No distinct untracked proposal remains and no new task was warranted. These are external to sase-1ok; the reproduced alert-reconciliation defect is remaining epic work and will be handled by a lander-authored tale.

LANDING AUDIT: All four phase notes and commits reviewed: 538736f0f2, 98cb07ebb8, 9cb35859c9, fabfff06e0, and linked core 03dce1f2; source pin includes AgentName. DECISIONS near_miss_mutation=refuse is implemented on close/open, including fast-path open. Reviewed non-epic drift through cef4bb1199 (Codex shadow sessions; publication retry/protection; failed-close recovery; core wheel pin; monitor-capacity projections). Seven focused test files passed 89 tests. No epic-symbol exemptions; parent_id is null. Remaining epic defect reproduced in isolated state: after a stranded-bead alert exists, close the bead and release its waiter outside wait_checks (ready.json already exists, or waiting.json removed); alert count stays 1 after both ticks. The tick has no pending waiter to seed reconciliation. Required remaining-work tale will seed targets from outstanding alerts, retain bounded cached queries and failure behavior, add regressions, and finish this epic closeout in the coder turn.

LIVE COLLECTOR ACCEPTANCE: Compared old session-only query with current any(agent_session,agent_name) on the same live project scopes using this checkout binding. gh_bobs-org__bob-cli unknown/no_records fell 8 -> 4; gh_sase-org__sase fell 149 -> 18. Current bob counts: unclosed 2, kept 2, blocked 1, waiting 2, queued 1, unknown 4. Current sase counts: unclosed 63, lost 15, kept 16, waiting 49, queued 3, running 8, monitor 6, blocked 39, delegated 12, unknown 18. All residual unknowns have records_available=true and zero members. Independently enumerated local ace-run artifact dirs via canonical path API: 3,030 bob and 17,699 sase dirs; inspected name and agent_session in agent_meta.json and done.json, with zero unreadable JSON files and zero matches for any residual assignee. Thus remaining unknowns genuinely have no local artifact record, not the single-turn filter miss. Residual bob bead IDs: bob-cli-3j, bob-cli-5w, bob-cli-8b, bob-cli-bj. Residual sase IDs: sase-12o, sase-12y.4, sase-12y.4.1, sase-158.6, sase-158.6.3, sase-169, sase-1e3, sase-1hi.10.7.6, sase-1oj, sase-1oj.6, sase-n4.5.4, sase-n4.5.4.1, sase-n4.5.4.2, sase-so.5, sase-so.5.1, sase-so.5.2, sase-w3, sase-yz. Counts are a live audit snapshot, not the older incident numbers in the plan.

FINAL PRE-PROPOSAL INTEGRATION UPDATE: Fetched and fast-forwarded e7d9f7a479, the late sase-1oj.4 adoption. It preserves this epic AgentName literal and core revision pin. Its four focused capacity test files give 36 passed and one still-failing fake-PID fixture (test_capacity_blocked_waiter_does_not_park_the_queue_behind_it); appended exact fresh evidence to sase-1oj.
